photos.c: PHOTOS by C. McLENNAN The 1968 "Garnet Cup at Bexley on February 3rd. Frank Jarvis (centre), this year's President of the R.W.A. (Southern), presents the Cup to Belgrave Harriers. Those seen in action are (8) Mayo,(6) Lawton, (3) Capener, (11) Ward, (9) Picton, (4) Cook, (5) Fotheringham. At bottom right, our scoring four join Frank in admiring their award.

Left: Hardly an event went by this summer without Doug Fotheringham's name appearing on the result sheet. At the Southern Counties Vets T&F League final he won the over 50 2k Walk to maintain our 100% record in all walks in this competition.
